newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion raises qtly div to $0.2525.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion raises qtly div to $0.2525.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc said Wednesday it has increased the quarterly dividend on its common stock to $0.2525 per share from $0.24.
The new quarterly dividend is payable for the first quarter on April 30, to shareholders of record April 11.

The company also declared a regular quarterly dividend on its nine percent series A cumulative redeemable preferred stock for the first quarter of 1997 in the amount of $.578125 per share. This dividend is payable on April 15, to shareholders of record April 1.
